cleavage agent: digested first using LysC in <4M urea and second using trypsin in <2M urea
instrument: LC1200 coupled to a Fusion Lumos, Thermo Scientific operated in high/high mode
labeling: Area was used to rank different protein abundances in the sample.
ptm: Oxidation of methionine (variable); protein N-terminal acetylation (variable); cysteine carbamidomethyl (fixed)
Oxidation of methionine and protein N-terminal acetylation were allowed as variable modifications, cysteine carbamidomethyl was set as a fixed modification
reduction reagent: resuspended in 8M urea/10mM dithiothreitol/0.1 M ammonium bicarbonate
reduction concentration: resuspended in 8M urea/10mM dithiothreitol/0.1 M ammonium bicarbonate
